stories.headline: Kyle Larson wins at Talladega for the first time
stories.summary: The YellaWood 500 was run at Talladega Superspeedway in Lincoln, Alabama, on 25 October. Kyle Larson won it, ahead of William Byron and Ricky Stenhouse Jr., and it was his first NASCAR Cup Series win at the circuit. An overtime finish stretched the race from 188 laps to 189.

stories.headline: Serbia's Student List wins the early election
stories.summary: Serbia elected a new National Assembly on 25 October, in an early election; one had originally been due by December 2027. The Student List won 53.3% of the valid votes, with 96.9% of polling stations counted, against 39.7% for the Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia list. Vučić conceded defeat, ending the Serbian Progressive Party's hold on power since 2012.

stories.headline: Bulgaria's presidential vote goes to a second round
stories.summary: Bulgaria voted for a president on 25 October. The incumbent, Iliana Iotova, took 35% of the vote and the former prime minister Andrey Gyurov 32%, so the two will meet again in a runoff on 1 November. Turnout was a record low.

stories.headline: A giant fungus turns up in China's forests
stories.summary: Scientists surveying forests in Yunnan, in China, have found a giant fungus new to science. Its upright reproductive structures reach 50 cm in height and can weigh as much as 2.2 kg, and the species has been named Dianjunus rex. Its family appears to have originated about 65 million years ago, roughly a million years after the extinction that ended the dinosaurs.

sources.excerpt: In auto racing, American driver Kyle Larson of Hendrick Motorsports wins the YellaWood 500 at the Talladega Superspeedway in Alabama, winning his first NASCAR Cup Series race at the circuit.
The Student List wins the election with 53% of the vote, with former president Aleksandar Vučić conceding defeat.
Incumbent Iliana Iotova wins and will face former acting prime minister Andrey Gyurov in a second round due to record low turnout and no candidate having a majority of the vote.
The 2026 YellaWood 500 was a NASCAR Cup Series race held on October 25, 2026, at Talladega Superspeedway in Lincoln, Alabama.

Contested over 189 laps on the 2.66 mile (4.28 km) superspeedway, extended from the original 188 laps due to a overtime finish, it was the 34th race of the 2026 NASCAR Cup Series season, and eighth race of The Chase.

Kyle Larson won the race. William Byron finished 2nd, and Ricky Stenhouse Jr. finished 3rd. Ross Chastain and Cole Custer rounded out the top five, and Carson Hocevar, Todd Gilliland, Denny Hamlin, Alex Bowman, and Michael McDowell rounded out the top ten.
Early parliamentary elections were held in Serbia on 25 October 2026 to elect members of the National Assembly. The elections were originally due by December 2027
The Student List won the election with a projected absolute majority of seats, defeating the Serbian Progressive Party (SNS), which had been in power since 2012.

According to preliminary results from the Republic Electoral Commission (RIK), with 96.9% of polling stations counted, the Student List won 53.3% of the valid votes and the SNS-led "Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia" list 39.7%
Presidential elections were held in Bulgaria on 25 October 2026. Incumbent president Iliana Iotova was eligible and ran for a full term.

In the first round, Iotova won 35% of the vote, with former Prime Minister Andrey Gyurov winning 32%. As no candidate won a majority of the votes, a runoff election will be held on 1 November between them.

In order to stand as a candidate, a person must be a Bulgarian citizen holding no other nationality, be at least 40 years of age by election day and have resided in the country for the previous five years.
Scientists exploring the forests of Yunnan, China, have discovered an extraordinary giant fungus that is challenging previous assumptions about how large certain fungi can grow.
The newly identified species, Dianjunus rex, produces upright reproductive structures that can reach 50 cm (20 inches) in height and weigh as much as 2.2 kg (4.9 pounds).

Their results suggest that the lineage originated approximately 65 million years ago, roughly one million years after the Cretaceous-Paleogene mass extinction. That catastrophic event eliminated the non-avian dinosaurs along with countless other animal and plant species.
